hook: SCP-5618 is short, but it is really two layers at once: an official file, and running margin comments between Researcher Stephen Zorić [SZ] and Dr. Alice Forth [AF], who are reviewing it before release. Read the comments as closely as the file itself. Near the bottom there is a "REFRESH FILE" prompt; follow it, because the second version is part of the piece.
whyItMatters:
The anomaly here is not an object but an event: the erasure of the very timeline the Foundation is living in. That turns the usual containment format inside out, since there is nothing to contain and the procedures are really instructions for how to end.

The article also uses clearance levels as a storytelling device. Each tier of staff is told a different version of the truth, and laying the tiers side by side shows exactly who the institution chooses to deceive.
thingsToNotice:
Read the instructions as a ladder. Level 0 staff get nothing and are to be killed outright; Levels 1-3 are told of a global crisis and locked down at their posts; Level 4 learns that a CK-class event is coming and that evacuation to other timelines will begin soon. Only Level 5 is told the truth, that the 1981 Multi-Foundation Pact forbids any evacuation or transfer, so the promised escape was never real.

The description reveals that this world is itself an alternate timeline, and that someone has succeeded in restoring baseline reality through a historical intervention, which means this timeline is being wiped. Forth tells Zorić to strip the placeholder notice and their own notes before publishing, yet both are still there, and the two sign off to each other in the margins of the final notice.

Refreshing brings up a blank file marked N/A, the same placeholder notice, and a different exchange: Zorić hopes they never have to fill it in, and Forth replies that if they ever do, the people doing it won't really be them for long.
